decision: Reconcile the 39 credential-shaped Class C findings per finding under the locked D1-D3 policies without a new founder question per finding?
whyItMatters: The 39 findings stay on the desk only because no mechanism consumes an already-decided per-finding disposition; the founder ruled they become individually verified canonical dispositions.
evidence: Founder authorization update 2026-11-06 (verbatim, section 2): "APPROVED: Evidence-backed, per-finding credential reconciliation under existing D1–D3 policies."

Steps (verbatim): "1. Match its canonical debt ID, source, fingerprint and original evidence. 2. Apply the previously locked D1, D2 or D3 ruling. 3. Require independent, source-bound verification of the exact finding. 4. Record its canonical disposition through the existing Steward decision and ledger mechanisms. 5. Re-observe to confirm its actual canonical state."
"A validated harmless or intentionally synthetic finding does not require another founder approval merely because the sensor classified it as C."

Limits (verbatim): "No blanket dismissal or scanner-wide exemption. No downgrading solely because a file is mirrored or under tests/. No closure based only on a self-authored disposition matrix. Actual exposed credentials, ambiguous provenance, changed source evidence or unresolved security risks remain Class C and require escalation. Preserve historical evidence, canonical authority and independent review."
C1-C4 remain binding; C2 migration and C3 GBrain curation remain deferred; C4 no-Copilot-billing unchanged.

Founder follow-up 2026-11-06 (verbatim): "hmm impeccable and firecrawl are almost always changing. Is there a security breach at all? if not these are merely class A or B at best... make the fix long term, D1 is still correct."

Lead implementation decision: bind dispositions to finding identity (path + pattern + token fingerprint + occurrence + normalized line hash), not whole-file bytes; new/changed credential-shaped findings route as Class B for lane verification and independently signed records; only high-confidence live-credential shapes or ambiguous provenance stay Class C.
recommended: Implement a narrow per-finding consumer (exact debt id + path + pattern + fingerprint + reviewed source hash) fed only by independently verified disposition records; unmatched/changed/new findings stay Class C.
